decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the firm's core thermoforming range for dental labs and had their own product page through 2019, so keeping them costs little.
PETG thermoforming blanks are a staple material for aligners and splints in lab workflows, giving steady demand and synergy with the existing material portfolio.
The UV-curing lacquer is a minor finishing consumable that was only mentioned on the site, but it supports the firm's earmold and dental workflows and is cheap to keep listed.
Custom hearing protection earmolds draw on the firm's core custom-device manufacturing and hearing-care channels, and demand is steady from occupational safety rules.
